minor.issue: Returns 500 'Budget has been exceeded' — Emergent LLM key OpenAI/Gemini budget hit during test run. Pre-existing infra constraint, NOT a regression from Friend Codes feature. Endpoint code itself unchanged.

critical_code_review_comments: _ensure_friend_code() correctly uses upsert + uniqueness check loop (up to 10 retries) before raising 500. Good collision safety even though 36^4 = 1.6M space.
add_friend handler order is safe: looks up target first → rejects self → fetches/creates me → idempotent on duplicate. Returns already_added boolean cleanly so UI can choose different toast.

duel/submit best-score logic uses `payload.correct > prior.correct` which correctly keeps the higher score; total is also updated only on improvement (acceptable but slightly inconsistent if a player plays a different-length duel — fine for current daily challenge which has fixed total).
duel/scores sort tuple `(-score, is_me==0 first, name)` puts me on top when tied — nice UX choice.
`import string` is locally placed inside the Friend section (line 1129) — works but unconventional; suggest hoisting to top with other imports for consistency. Not a bug.
friend_code uniqueness has no MongoDB index; for scale, add `db.players.create_index('friend_code', unique=True, sparse=True)` on startup.
remove_friend always returns 200 even if me doesn't exist or friend_player_id wasn't in list — silent no-op. Acceptable for idempotency but worth documenting.
Frontend Friends.jsx properly handles all 4 toast variants (add/duplicate/self/invalid) and uses e.response.data.detail from axios error for backend message — clean integration.
Friend-code-input maxLength=9 matches STRY-XXXX length and onKeyDown=Enter triggers onAdd — good keyboard UX.
